title: The Overnight
audience: adult literary readers who like quiet, grounded realism and craft
reader_contract: strictly linear: one night, 2 a.m. to dawn; no flashback, no framing device
a concrete problem with a clear cause and a clear, earned turn
accessible, sensory prose; feeling is carried by the hands' work, not named
a quiet, legible ending: recognition, not triumph; no twist, no cryptic withholding
theme_question: What does it take to stop measuring yourself against the person who taught you, and make something that is your own?
desired_affect: the steadiness of competence under pressure
constraints: events happen in the order the reader receives them; no gimmick structure
no magic and no coincidence-rescue; the fix comes from Nadia's own competence
prose earns feeling through concrete action; no told emotion, no cliche, no adverbial dialogue tags
the customer does not deliver tidy validation
